segments.name: Game & Network Services (G&NS)
segments.description: Develops and sells PlayStation hardware, game software, add-on content and network services for consumers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The G&NS segment includes the production and sales of digital software and add-on content, the network services businesses and the manufacture and sales of home gaming products.

segments.name: Music
segments.description: Develops, produces and distributes recorded music, manages and licenses song rights, and produces anime content and game applications.
segments.evidence: The Music segment includes the Recorded Music, Music Publishing and Visual Media & Platform businesses.

segments.name: Pictures
segments.description: Produces, acquires and distributes motion pictures and television programming and operates television networks and streaming services worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Pictures segment includes the Motion Pictures, Television Productions and Media Networks businesses.

segments.name: Entertainment, Technology & Services (ET&S)
segments.description: Makes and sells consumer electronics including cameras, audio products, televisions, displays, smartphones and related network services.
segments.evidence: The ET&S segment includes the Imaging business, the Sound business, the Network Services business and the Displays business.

segments.name: Imaging & Sensing Solutions (I&SS)
segments.description: Manufactures and sells CMOS image sensors and other semiconductors used mainly in smartphones, cameras, factory automation and automobiles.
segments.evidence: The I&SS segment includes the image sensors business.

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Consists of various operating activities including disc manufacturing outside Japan and recording and storage media businesses.
segments.evidence: All Other consists of various operating activities, including the disc manufacturing business outside of Japan, and the recording media and storage media businesses.

revenueModel.text: Sony earns revenue from consumers and distributors buying hardware, software, content and electronics, from licensing and royalties on music compositions, and from distribution of films and streaming services.
revenueModel.evidence: Digital software, including add-on content, is primarily sold via the PlayStation ™ Store, while software for third-party platforms is sold via third-party distributors.

changes.text: In October 2025, Sony completed the Partial Spin-off of its Financial Services business, which ceased to be a consolidated subsidiary and was excluded from reporting segments.
changes.evidence: In October 2025, the execution of the Partial Spin-off of the Financial Services business was completed.
